directory of markdown posts and their session transcripts into a static
site: plain files, servable by any static host, no server of its own. One
feature no blog engine has: every post's page shows which words the AI wrote
and the prompt each came from, derived from the transcript that wrote it,
and a toggleable summary per section. Every requir

/**
 * The site's own AI bonds.
 *
 * The site has no API and no request-time AI: these two exist for
 * `scripts/site-build.mjs`, which bonds whichever provider it finds a key for
 * and uses it to write the section summaries into the cache before Vite runs.
 * They are set up by the build script itself — `setupProviders()` (the app's
 * provider wiring) deliberately leaves them alone, so the browser bundle never
 * pulls an AI vendor in.
 */

export { AI_MODEL, setupAiAnthropic } from './ai-anthropic.js'
export { setupAiSummarizationLlm } from './ai-summarization-llm.js'
